name: metlife-cover-letter-outlook-helper
description: Local Windows Helper — the ONLY part of the web migration that still needs Windows/COM privileges. Runs on each agent's own machine, listens on 127.0.0.1 only, and drives Outlook via the SAME PowerShell script the original Electron app used.

scripts.package: echo "Use electron-builder, pkg, or nexe to produce a Windows EXE from this folder — see README.md's 'Packaging the Helper' section."
